department: David R. Cheriton School of Computer Science

deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 for September 2027; reference letters are due within 14 days after the deadline.
deadline.quote: December 1 (for admission in September of the following year)

gre_subject.value: No GRE test of any kind is required.
gre_subject.quote: No, the GRE is not required for any student applying to a Computer Science graduate program.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required for any applicant, including internationals.
gre_general.quote: No, the GRE is not required for any student applying to a Computer Science graduate program.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL 5 on the new 1-6 scale, with 4.5 in writing and 4 in speaking.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing and 6.5 in speaking.

supervisor.value: No supervisor is needed to apply, but you need one to be accepted; list preferred supervisors and contact them early.
supervisor.quote: You do not need a supervisor to apply, but you do need one to be accepted!

funding.value: All full-time PhD students receive a funding package, and all admitted students are considered for admission scholarships.
funding.quote: All full-time MMath and PhD students in the School of Computer Science receive funding packages.

entry_route.value: A master's in CS with 78% is the normal route; outstanding CS bachelor's graduates may apply directly, and some PhD applicants are admitted to the MMath first.
entry_route.quote: A master's degree in computer science with a 78% average. | Student with an undergraduate degree in computer science may apply for admission directly to the PhD program.
